h1: Plastic and Silicone Drinkware Alternatives to Glass
lead: Compare plastic and silicone models for venues seeking alternatives to conventional glass drinkware. Choose the actual model by its material, shape and intended service.
html:
Avoid an absolute breakage claim

The term unbreakable is not a universal damage guarantee. Wall construction, handling, temperature and product configuration still matter when comparing drinkware for a venue.
